svg.title: A groom seated on a decorated ivory horse, greeting celebrating guests beside a dhol player and floral parasols. Smooth representative figures, not Shubh and Suchita.
svg.metadata: Character styling and facial proportions informed by Fliqa India, https://www.pexels.com/photo/elegant-indian-wedding-couple-portrait-33318112/, under Pexels License, https://www.pexels.com/license/. New function-specific poses, garments, scene compositions and settings are drawn for this invitation. No photograph pixels are embedded. No endorsement is implied.
